powers.name: Bond Famulus
powers.cost: Feed the animal a Rouse Check of your blood on three different nights (at CC it’s assumed done).
powers.notes: One famulus only; normal animal ghouls don’t require this.

powers.name: Sense the Beast
powers.notes: Detects hostility and supernatural traits.

powers.name: Animal Messenger
powers.cost: 1 Rouse Check per night of searching.
powers.dice_pool: None (Famulus tests when target location unknown)
powers.notes: Famulus rolls Resolve + Streetwise/Survival (diff 2) if target’s location is unknown; Intelligence + Streetwise/Survival if the target is actively hiding.

powers.name: Atavism
powers.duration: Rounds equal to margin + 1, or whole scene on Critical Win.
powers.notes: Target animal must be able to sense you; reverts it to primal instincts.

powers.name: Feral Whispers
powers.cost: 1 Rouse Check per type of animal (free on your Famulus).
powers.notes: Two-way communication with animals; can also summon.

powers.name: Leash the Beast
powers.notes: Channel their Blood to prevent the Beast from awakening. Can also turn one die's failure into a success with Frenzy tests.
powers.source: Live from the Succubus Club p.27

powers.name: Tracing the Blood
powers.notes: Understand how others Rouse the Blood detecting Blood Surges, Blush of Life, or Disciplines. Must be in sensory range. Margin determines amount of info obtained.

powers.name: Messenger's Command
powers.cost: None (beyond Animal Messenger & the Dominate power used).
powers.prerequisite: Animal Messenger AND Compel or Mesmerize
powers.notes: Dominate rating used Through Famulus cannot exceed your Animalism rating.

powers.name: Animal Succulence
powers.notes: Slake extra Hunger from animals; counts Blood Potency as 2 lower for slaking penalties (never to 0).

powers.name: Plague of Beasts
powers.notes: Marks a target; they take margin as penalty to non-Physical Skill pools; easier to track.

powers.name: Quell the Beast
powers.duration: Scene (vampires: several turns equal to margin + 1).
powers.notes: Suppress a vampire’s Beast or render mortals lethargic.

powers.name: Scent of Prey
powers.duration: One scene (one night on Critical Win).
powers.notes: Track a mortal who witnessed a Masquerade breach.

powers.name: Unliving Hive
powers.notes: Extend Animalism influence to swarms; treat swarm as a single creature.

powers.name: Augury
powers.notes: Compel a swarm to “answer” a question; all Animalism tests +1 Difficulty for the rest of session.

powers.name: Awaken the Parasite
powers.notes: As printed.

powers.name: Subsume the Spirit
powers.notes: Possess an animal’s body.

powers.name: Sway the Flock
powers.cost: One or more Rouse Checks (extend range/influence).
powers.notes: Area influence over animal behavior; greater successes = stronger control.

powers.name: Animal Dominion
powers.duration: One scene, or until directive fulfilled.
powers.notes: Command existing packs/flocks (does not summon).

powers.name: Coax the Bestial Temper
powers.notes: Increase or decrease Frenzy resistance Difficulty by margin.

powers.name: Drawing Out the Beast
powers.notes: Transfer terror or fury Frenzy to a nearby victim (not Hunger Frenzy).

powers.name: Spirit Walk
powers.notes: Project from one animal to another without returning to your own body.

powers.name: Heightened Senses
powers.notes: Add Auspex rating to perception rolls. Long activation may cost Willpower at ST discretion.

powers.name: Sense the Unseen
powers.notes: Detect supernatural activity; vs Obfuscate roll opposed (user Wits + Auspex).

powers.name: Panacea (Errata)
powers.cost: 1 Rouse (additional targets same night: spend Willpower = half margin)
powers.notes: Heals Willpower / calms; special multi-target cost per errata.

powers.name: Premonition
powers.notes: ST may trigger passively at no cost; active visions require Rouse + roll.

powers.name: Reveal Temperament
powers.notes: Smell Resonance and detect Dyscrasia; on Kindred, reveals last feed info.

powers.name: Unerring Pursuit
powers.opposing_pool: None (victim may roll Wits + Awareness once to glimpse pursuer)
powers.notes: Supernatural tracking of a victim.

powers.name: Vermin Vision (Errata)
powers.notes: Share senses with animals; works Through groups (errata).

powers.name: Fatal Flaw
powers.notes: Discerns a target’s weakness (mental or physical).

powers.name: Scry the Soul
powers.notes: Read a single target or scan a crowd for auras / influences.

powers.name: Share the Senses
powers.notes: Tap into another’s senses; Sense the Unseen may allow victim to notice.

powers.name: Haruspex
powers.notes: Use a mortal corpse (died within the scene) to reroll dice before night’s end.

powers.name: Read the Room
powers.duration: Instantaneous or one scene on Critical Win.
powers.notes: ST discretion on if a question is too complex. Difficulty lessens with more people present.

powers.name: Reveal the Invisible Leash
powers.duration: As long as vampire touches target.
powers.notes: Most immediate superiors are detected first, margin may give more superiors.

powers.name: Spirit's Touch
powers.notes: Read emotional residue from objects/locations (from most recent backward).

powers.name: Heart Laid Bare
powers.notes: Discern a target’s deepest fear or desire.

powers.name: Clairvoyance
powers.duration: Few minutes up to one night
powers.notes: Remote information gathering; can monitor ongoing events.

powers.name: Possession
powers.notes: Possess a mortal; does not grant target’s Throughs/skills/impersonation.

powers.name: Telepathy
powers.duration: 1 minute per Rouse (full scene if consenting)
powers.notes: Read minds; projecting Throughs to others requires no roll.

powers.name: Unburdening the Bestial Soul
powers.notes: Remove or protect against Stains; only works on vampires with lower Humanity.

powers.name: Corrosive Vitae
powers.notes: Turns vitae corrosive. Does not harm unliving flesh (e.g., vampires).

powers.name: Shape the Sanguine Sacrament (Errata)
powers.cost: Free (1 Rouse if using own vitae)
powers.notes: Shape blood into images or constructs; errata applied.
powers.source: Winter's Teeth #3; Book of Nod Apocrypha p.33; Tattered Façade p.92

powers.name: A Taste for Blood
powers.notes: Discern traits of another via their blood.

powers.name: Koldunic Sorcery
powers.notes: Attune with and sense Through one element (e.g., Water). May be taken multiple times for other elements.

powers.name: Blood's Curse
powers.notes: Temporarily increases a vampire's Bane Severity. Ghouls/thin-bloods/Caitiff gain a clan bane.

powers.name: Extinguish Vitae
powers.notes: Increases a Kindred’s Hunger. If the victim sees the user, they may ID them with Intelligence + Occult vs Wits + Subterfuge.

powers.name: Scour Secrets (Errata)
powers.duration: One night, or until info found / dead-end
powers.notes: Rapidly parse large amounts of content. Does not translate unknown languages. Errata applied.
powers.source: Players Guide p.98; Book of Nod Apocrypha p.34

powers.name: Blood of Potency
powers.notes: Temporarily increases Blood Potency (can bypass generation limit).

powers.name: Scorpion's Touch
powers.notes: Turns vitae into paralyzing poison. Mortals taking any damage fall unconscious.

powers.name: Transitive Bond
powers.notes: Extends blood bond properties Through vitae. Originated with Tremere; resurfaced in Sabbat.

powers.name: Ripples of the Heart
powers.notes: Manipulate the blood/resonance of others; can inflict Compulsions on those who feed from tainted blood or alter mortal Resonance.

powers.name: Theft of Vitae
powers.notes: Pull blood Through the air to feed. Victim experiences the Kiss.

powers.name: Blood Aegis
powers.duration: One scene or until damage spent
powers.notes: Protective barrier: each Rouse reduces incoming damage by 5.

powers.name: Fulminating Vitae
powers.notes: Vitae bomb. Deals Aggravated to Kindred, Superficial to mortals.

powers.name: Marionette
powers.duration: One turn per point of margin
powers.notes: Control the blood within a living or dead body.

powers.name: Vinculum Magnum
powers.notes: Creates a blood bond between two targets that drank the user's Blood in the same scene.

powers.name: Baal's Caress
powers.notes: User’s vitae becomes lethal poison. Mortals die instantly on 1+ damage.

powers.name: Cauldron of Blood
powers.notes: Boils the victim’s blood. Mortals die screaming on 1+ damage.

powers.name: Reclamation of Vitae
powers.notes: Reclaim vitae used to create ghouls over distance. Non-Sabbat users take Stains.

powers.name: Cat's Grace
powers.notes: Automatically pass balance tests; does not work on objects that cannot support your weight.

powers.name: Fluent Swiftness
powers.notes: Reroll Blood Surge on a Dexterity or Celerity test.

powers.name: Rapid Reflexes
powers.notes: Faster reactions and minor actions; no penalty for having no cover in firefights.

powers.name: Fleetness
powers.notes: Add Celerity rating to non-combat Dexterity tests or once per turn when defending with eligible pools.

powers.name: Rush Job
powers.notes: Perform a Skill task that would take a long time in mere seconds. Does not speed up attacks or defenses.

powers.name: Blink
powers.notes: Close distance near-instantaneously in a straight line; terrain may require checks.

powers.name: Traversal
powers.notes: Dash across vertical surfaces or over liquid briefly. ST should warn if target is too far.

powers.name: Weaving
powers.notes: Remove penalty from dodging multiple ranged opponents; add Celerity rating to ranged dodges.

powers.name: A Thousand Cuts
powers.notes: Add Celerity to Brawl/Melee to automatically Impair mortals; against Kindred is a Masquerade breach. Only with claws or edged weapons.

powers.name: Blurred Momentum
powers.duration: Until the user lets it lapse
powers.notes: Attacks with fewer successes than your Celerity rating miss, even for powers that normally disallow defense.

powers.name: Draught of Elegance
powers.duration: One night; for drinkers until your next feeding or at Hunger 5
powers.notes: Imbue your vitae with Celerity; each recipient must drink vitae equal to one Rouse Check.

powers.name: Unerring Aim
powers.notes: Act as the world slows; attackers with Celerity 5 may spend a Rouse to nullify and defend.

powers.name: Unseen Strike
powers.notes: Vanish and reappear for a surprise attack on success; otherwise follows Blink attack/movement rules.

powers.name: Faster than Light
powers.notes: While using Blink, make an additional Rouse Check to pass through areas of sunlight or fire without damage or their effect. Does not negate other impacts from daylight or fire.
powers.source: Live from the Succubus Club p.27

powers.name: Lightning Strike
powers.notes: Attack with impossible speed; targets with Celerity 5 may spend a Rouse to nullify and defend.

powers.name: Split Second
powers.notes: Briefly alter events just declared by the ST within reason: something achievable in a few real-time seconds.

powers.name: Cloud Memory
powers.notes: Erase memory of the current moment. No roll vs unprepared mortals.

powers.name: Compel
powers.notes: Issue a simple command. No roll vs unprepared mortals; mortals already Dominated this scene or acting against their nature may roll to resist.

powers.name: Slavish Devotion (Errata)
powers.notes: Victims already under your Dominate resist third-party Dominate: attackers take a dice penalty equal to the victim’s Fortitude. (Errata)
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.104; Players Guide p.73

powers.name: Mesmerize
powers.duration: Until command is carried out or scene ends
powers.notes: Issue complex commands. No roll vs unprepared mortals; if against their nature they may roll to resist.

powers.name: Dementation
powers.notes: You must have had a conversation with the target to use this.

powers.name: Domitor's Favor
powers.notes: While Blood-Bonded, defiance is harder. On a total fail of defiance rolls, the bond does not weaken that month.

powers.name: The Stolen Voice
powers.notes: Target cannot speak, write, or gesture to express. No activation test vs mortals.

powers.name: Forgetful Mind
powers.notes: Rewrite memories; each point of margin allows one additional memory to be altered.

powers.name: Submerged Directive
powers.notes: Implant a standing suggestion/order that never expires until completed. One directive per target at a time.

powers.name: Chain of Command
powers.duration: Until the command is carried out.
powers.notes: Force the victim to issue the given command to their inferiors or anyone they interact with if their inferiors are unknown.

powers.name: Ancestral Dominion (Errata)
powers.duration: Until carried out or scene ends
powers.notes: Urge a descendant to act, even against their opinion. Target gains +1 die to resist per generation separating you. (Errata)
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.104; Players Guide p.74

powers.name: Implant Suggestion
powers.notes: Temporarily alter personality/opinion. No test vs unprepared mortals unless it opposes core beliefs.

powers.name: Rationalize
powers.notes: Victims believe Dominated actions were their own idea; if pressed, they may test to question their actions.

powers.name: Tabula Rasa
powers.notes: Erase identity-level memories. Often followed by lies and Path indoctrination (Sabbat practice).

powers.name: Lethe's Call
powers.notes: Erase weeks of memory. Unprepared mortals cannot resist. With a verbal command only memories around the spoken subject are erased.

powers.name: Mass Manipulation
powers.cost: 1 Rouse in addition to the amplified power
powers.notes: Apply a Dominate power to multiple targets who see your eyes. Roll once vs the strongest target.

powers.name: Terminal Decree
powers.notes: Allows commands that override self-preservation. Such commands are always resisted (never auto-succeed).

powers.name: Fluent Endurance
powers.notes: Reroll the Blood Surge rouse check on a Stamina or Fortitude test.

powers.name: Resilience
powers.notes: Add your Fortitude rating to your Health track.

powers.name: Unswayable Mind
powers.notes: Add Fortitude to rolls resisting coercion, intimidation, or supernatural influence.

powers.name: Earth's Perseverance
powers.notes: Become impossible to move from your spot (you can still be harmed; floor may fail).

powers.name: Enduring Beasts
powers.notes: Share your toughness with animals (especially your Famulus).

powers.name: Invigorating Vitae
powers.cost: None (aside from Rouse to donate blood)
powers.notes: Your vitae heals mortals faster. Usual risks of ghouling/blood bond still apply.

powers.name: Obdurate
powers.notes: Keep footing when struck by massive force. Superficial damage from impacts is reduced by Fortitude before halving.

powers.name: Toughness
powers.notes: Subtract Fortitude rating from all Superficial damage before halving (cannot reduce below 1).

powers.name: Self-Assurance
powers.notes: Replace one damage done to your Willpower track to Superficial damage. It can only be used once per scene.

powers.name: Defy Bane
powers.notes: Convert Aggravated to Superficial damage; you cannot heal that Superficial damage this scene.

powers.name: Fortify the Inner Façade
powers.notes: Increase the Difficulty of mind-reading/piercing powers by half your Fortitude (round up). If rules allow resisting, add Fortitude to your pool instead.

powers.name: Seal the Beast's Maw
powers.notes: Ignore Hunger effects if you do not gain Hunger from the Rouse rolls; reduce dice pools. If any pool drops to 0, test for Fury Frenzy.

powers.name: Valeren
powers.notes: Mend an injured vampire. A subject can benefit only once per night.

powers.name: Calloused Soul
powers.notes: Pre-emptively take Stains to prevent/reduce later Stains. Actually gain 3 Stains now; one may be mitigated by a Conviction.

powers.name: Draught of Endurance
powers.cost: 1 Rouse (+ recipients must drink one Rouse worth)
powers.notes: Your vitae grants Fortitude to others until your next feeding/Hunger 5 as applicable.

powers.name: Gorgon’s Scales
powers.notes: Resonance-based bonuses: Choleric resists staking; Melancholic reduces fire damage; Phlegmatic strengthens vs Auspex; Sanguine reduces sunlight damage.

powers.name: Shatter
powers.notes: Your attacker takes the damage your Toughness would subtract; weapons may break if their modifier threshold is met.
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.104

powers.name: Flesh of Marble
powers.notes: Ignore the first source of physical damage each turn (not sunlight). Critical wins on attacks bypass this.

powers.name: Prowess from Pain
powers.notes: No penalties from Health damage; increase one Attribute per damage level on your tracker (max Blood Surge value + 6).

powers.name: Meat Shields
powers.duration: One scene (or until you leave targets)
powers.notes: Increase Fortitude by half the number of weak mortals present (rounded down), max +5.

powers.name: Will to Survive
powers.notes: If a vampire were to suffer Aggravated damage equal to or higher than their remaining Health boxes that would result in Final Death, they drop to Torpor instead. This costs no actions but the vampire must have a Blood Potency of at least 2.

powers.name: Cloak of Shadows
powers.notes: Blend into surroundings while still; follows general Obfuscate limits.

powers.name: Ensconce
powers.notes: Others ignore small objects held on your person. Sense the Unseen can pierce.

powers.name: Silence of Death
powers.notes: Nullifies sounds you make; does not mute noises outside your personal space.

powers.name: Mask of Ages
powers.duration: Until sunrise or ended by user
powers.notes: Storytellers may limit the amount of bonus dice dependent on the number of decades between their projected and real age.
powers.source: Live from the Succubus Club p.28

powers.name: Cache
powers.duration: One scene or until dawn (extend with extra Rouse)
powers.notes: Hide unattended objects from notice.

powers.name: Chimerstry
powers.notes: Brief but realistic hallucinations; a target can only be affected once per conflict (errata).

powers.name: Ghost's Passing
powers.notes: Bestow Obfuscate onto an animal’s tracks. Sense the Unseen applies per general rules.

powers.name: Unseen Passage
powers.notes: Move while hidden. Fails if you are actively watched at activation.

powers.name: Ventriloquism (Errata)
powers.notes: Throw your voice to a chosen hearer within line of sight.

powers.name: Doubletalk
powers.notes: Say one thing publicly while conveying a hidden message; bystanders may contest.

powers.name: Fata Morgana (Errata)
powers.notes: Elaborate hallucinations; Frenzy triggers are at −1 Difficulty vs the illusion (errata).

powers.name: Ghost in the Machine
powers.notes: Your Obfuscate carries Through live video; recordings later appear blurred/hard to ID.

powers.name: Mask of a Thousand Faces
powers.notes: Appear as a forgettable, mundane face; you can interact and converse while masked.

powers.name: Mask of Isolation
powers.notes: Force Mask of a Thousand Faces onto a victim; if they realize it, the effect ends.

powers.name: Mental Maze (Errata)
powers.notes: Victim loses sense of direction/location within an area. Requires eye contact (errata).
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.85; Players Guide p.77

powers.name: Mind Masque
powers.notes: Hide/replace emotions & Throughs from supernatural readers; higher complexity raises Difficulty.

powers.name: Guise of the Departed
powers.notes: Adopt appearance & mannerisms of a recently dead mortal. Sense the Unseen can pierce.

powers.name: Conceal
powers.notes: Cloak an inanimate object (≤ two-story house; not self-moving).

powers.name: Vanish
powers.prerequisite: Cloak of Shadows (to augment Cloak/Unseen Passage)
powers.notes: Activate Cloak/Unseen Passage while observed; mortals’ memories fog, vampires’ do not.

powers.name: Seclusion
powers.notes: Target cannot see/hear any being. Physical harm lets target test again to end effect.

powers.name: Cloak the Gathering
powers.cost: 1 Rouse (plus the cost of the extended power)
powers.notes: Extend your Obfuscate to allies up to your Wits; exceed with extra Rouse Checks.

powers.name: Impostor's Guise
powers.notes: Assume a specific person’s appearance; study for 5+ minutes from multiple angles.

powers.name: Ashes to Ashes
powers.notes: Dissolves a corpse; animated bodies require tests.
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.204; Players Guide p.85

powers.name: Binding Fetter (Errata)
powers.notes: Identify a wraith’s fetter; suffer −2 to Awareness, Wits, and Resolve while active.
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.204; Players Guide p.85

powers.name: Oblivion Sight (Errata)
powers.notes: See in darkness; perceive ghosts. −2 dice to social rolls with mortals while active.
powers.source: Chicago by Night p.293; Players Guide p.85

powers.name: Shadow Cloak
powers.notes: +2 to Stealth and to Intimidation vs mortals.
powers.source: Chicago by Night p.293; Players Guide p.85; Fall of London p.264

powers.name: Arms of Ahriman (Errata)
powers.notes: Control shadow appendages; you can do nothing else while controlling them. Arms have no Health; escape does not require Composure + Resolve (errata).
powers.source: Chicago by Night p.294; Players Guide p.86

powers.name: Fatal Prediction (Updated)
powers.notes: Increase chance of mortal harm from external forces. Each success over margin deals 1 Aggravated over duration. You may not interact with the victim directly/indirectly.

powers.name: Fatal Precognition
powers.notes: Vision of a non-vampire’s death; you must see or hear the target during use.
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.204

powers.name: Shadow Cast
powers.notes: Conjure shadows from your body up to 2 × Oblivion rating meters/yards. Targets in shadow take extra Willpower damage in social conflict.
powers.source: Chicago by Night p.293; Players Guide p.87

powers.name: Where the Veil Thins (Errata)
powers.notes: Determine local Shroud density and effects (see chart in source).
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.205; Players Guide p.87

powers.name: Aura of Decay (Errata)
powers.notes: Plants wilt; animals/humans sicken; food spoils. −2 dice to your social rolls; contaminated food inflicts 2 Superficial (errata).
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.205; Players Guide p.88

powers.name: Passion Feast (Errata)
powers.notes: Slake Hunger on wraiths’ passion; Hunger does not return the next night (errata).
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.206; Players Guide p.89

powers.name: Shadow Perspective
powers.notes: Project senses into a shadow in line of sight. Only supernatural means (e.g., Sense the Unseen) can detect it.
powers.source: Chicago by Night p.294; Players Guide p.89

powers.name: Shadow Servant
powers.notes: Command a shadow to spy or frighten; it has no mind and is destroyed by bright light.

powers.name: Touch of Oblivion (Errata)
powers.notes: Wither a body part by touch (must grip the target). May warrant Stains at ST discretion (errata).
powers.source: Chicago by Night p.294; Players Guide p.89

powers.name: Necrotic Plague (Errata)
powers.duration: Activate in one turn; condition length varies
powers.notes: Supernatural illness; mundane treatment fails: only vitae heals. No outcome on Total Failure (errata).
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.206; Players Guide p.89

powers.name: Stygian Shroud
powers.notes: Spew darkness from a nearby shadow, covering area up to 2 × Oblivion rating meters/yards.
powers.source: Chicago by Night p.295; Players Guide p.90

powers.name: Umbrous Clutch
powers.notes: Open a victim’s shadow as a portal and drop them into your arms. Unprepared mortals are terrified; vampires test Frenzy (Fear/Fury) at Difficulty 4.

powers.name: Shadow Step
powers.notes: Step into one shadow and out of another within sight. You may take a willing passenger; if you gain a Stain, they do too.
powers.source: Chicago by Night p.295; Players Guide p.90

powers.name: Skuld Fulfilled (Errata)
powers.notes: Reintroduce recovered illnesses. On ghouls, removes anti-aging and purges vitae (errata on pools).
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.207; Players Guide p.91

powers.name: Tenebrous Avatar
powers.notes: Become living shadow; move over any surface/Through small gaps; only sunlight/fire harm you.
powers.source: Chicago by Night p.295; Players Guide p.91

powers.name: Withering Spirit
powers.notes: Erode a victim’s spirit to a husk. If they are Impaired, they will not return as a wraith.
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.208

powers.name: Fluent Strength
powers.notes: Reroll Blood Surge rouse checks on Strength or Potence rolls.

powers.name: Lethal Body
powers.notes: Unarmed attacks deal Aggravated to mortals and ignore 1 armor per Potence dot.

powers.name: Soaring Leap
powers.notes: Leap a distance in meters equal to 3 × Potence rating.

powers.name: Prowess
powers.notes: Add Potence to unarmed damage and to Feats of Strength; add half Potence (round up) to Melee damage.

powers.name: Relentless Grasp
powers.notes: Supernatural grip strength; does not aid the initial grapple test.

powers.name: Brutal Feed
powers.notes: Feeding becomes a violent, seconds-long act that slakes Hunger rapidly. Against vampires, required feeding actions are halved (round down).

powers.name: Exuberance
powers.notes: Treat Potence rating as two levels higher when using Potence powers. This can take the relative discipline above the limit of 5. But when a critical or failure is rolled, take Aggravated Damage.

powers.name: Spark of Rage
powers.notes: Incite a person or crowd to violence; add Potence rating to the effect.

powers.name: Uncanny Grip
powers.notes: Cling to/climb most surfaces unsupported. Leaves obvious damage traces.

powers.name: Wrecker
powers.notes: Double Potence rating for Feats of Strength vs objects/structures. Not usable against living targets.

powers.name: Draught of Might
powers.cost: 1 Rouse (+ recipients must drink one Rouse worth)
powers.notes: Your vitae grants Potence to others until your next feeding/Hunger 5 as applicable.

powers.name: Crash Down
powers.notes: Create a damaging shock on landing. Targets who total fail or suffer 3+ damage are knocked prone.

powers.name: Earth Shock
powers.notes: Create a shockwave that throws opponents prone.

powers.name: Fist of Caine
powers.notes: Your blows inflict Aggravated Health damage to mortals and supernaturals alike.

powers.name: Subtle Hammer
powers.notes: Focus your power into a single body part. You cannot make a second attack in the same move; limited-mobility body parts gain +4 dice (or more) to appropriate actions.

powers.name: Awe
powers.notes: Add Presence rating to Persuasion/Performance/Charisma-adjacent rolls (ST discretion). Victims revert to prior opinions when it ends.

powers.name: Daunt
powers.notes: Add Presence rating to Intimidation rolls. Cannot be used with Awe simultaneously.

powers.name: Eyes of the Serpent
powers.duration: Until eye contact breaks or scene ends
powers.notes: Immobilize with eye contact. Vampire victims may spend Willpower to break it after the first turn.

powers.name: Lingering Kiss (Errata)
powers.notes: During feeding, grant a Social Attribute bonus; afterward, victim suffers equal penalty when not pursuing the “fix.” Doesn’t work on Blood-Bonded; Unbondable cannot take this power.

powers.name: Melpominee
powers.notes: Use Awe, Daunt, Dread Gaze, Entrancement, and Majesty without seeing the target as long as they can hear you (earshot; not electronic by default).

powers.name: Predator's Lure
powers.duration: One scene, or until target is within 3 meters
powers.notes: Instill intense curiosity to compel a target to approach. Automatically works on mortals. Target will not risk danger or immediately drop everything. Cannot be used in a fight.

powers.name: Clear the Field (Errata)
powers.notes: Calmly clear an area; you may exempt a number of people equal to your Composure (errata).

powers.name: Dread Gaze
powers.notes: Instill fear; on a critical win vs a vampire, target tests Terror Frenzy at Difficulty 3.

powers.name: Entrancement
powers.notes: Target becomes devoted to keeping you pleased; you add Presence rating to social rolls against them. Harmful/tenet-opposed requests prompt a new test or the effect ends.

powers.name: Passion Leech
powers.notes: Leech the passion from a mortal target, gaining the benefits of Humanity 10 temporarily. Can only be gained once per night.

powers.name: Thrown Voice
powers.notes: Project your voice to any point in sight; usually no roll unless combined with Irresistible Voice/Melpominee/etc.

powers.name: True Love's Face
powers.notes: Victim perceives you as someone they strongly love/hate; can cause Stains if that person is their Touchstone.
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.85

powers.name: Invigorating Display
powers.notes: After interacting with a crowd, inhale their energy to experience a unique Resonance (usually intense, can be acute on a critical).
powers.source: Live from the Succubus Club p.28

powers.name: Inflame Desire
powers.notes: Boost a victim's current desire, seeking only to satisfy it. Inflicts the Need Compulsion on the victim.

powers.name: Irresistible Voice
powers.notes: Your voice alone suffices to use Dominate. Does not function Through technology.

powers.name: Magnum Opus
powers.notes: Infuse artwork with Presence; audiences resist to avoid its effects.

powers.name: Suffuse the Edifice
powers.notes: Extend a Presence power onto a building; if you are present, you become the focus instead.

powers.name: Summon
powers.notes: Call someone who’s tasted your vitae or been affected by specific Presence powers. They won’t harm themselves to reach you.

powers.name: Wingman
powers.notes: Grant another character use of your Presence power. Using the same power together doesn’t stack bonuses.

powers.name: Majesty
powers.notes: All who look upon you are awestruck and can only act for self-preservation; a win grants 1 turn +1 per margin of freedom.

powers.name: Star Magnetism
powers.cost: 1 additional Rouse (on top of the power used)
powers.notes: Transmit Presence Through live-feed technology (not recordings). When using Entrancement, speak the target’s name clearly.

powers.name: Eyes of the Beast
powers.notes: See in total darkness; +2 dice to Intimidation vs mortals while active.

powers.name: Squirm
powers.notes: Turn flesh and bones rubbery, squeezing through tight spaces. With a Rouse check, fit into spaces down to two inches in diameter.

powers.name: Weight of the Feather
powers.notes: Make yourself nearly weightless.

powers.name: Feral Weapons
powers.notes: Extend claws (+2 damage) or fangs (no called-shot penalty). Your Superficial damage is not halved.

powers.name: Vicissitude
powers.notes: Sculpt your own flesh; each success permits one change.

powers.name: Serpent's Kiss
powers.notes: When biting, inject your vitae into the target (can carry effects like Scorpion’s Touch).

powers.name: The False Sip
powers.notes: Prevent any blood/vitae from entering your system; vomit it up within the scene or extend once.

powers.name: Earth Meld
powers.duration: One day or more, or until disturbed
powers.notes: Merge with natural earth/soil (not artificial surfaces).

powers.name: Fleshcrafting
powers.notes: Reshape others; margin = number of changes you can make.

powers.name: Shapechange
powers.notes: Transform into an animal of similar mass; gain its Physical Attributes/traits.

powers.name: Visceral Absorption
powers.notes: Absorb blood/remains to clean a scene; reduce Hunger by 1 per body up to your Blood Sorcery rating (not below 0).

powers.name: Masque of Death
powers.duration: Until ended by user, waking from Torpor, or sunrise
powers.notes: Take on the appearance of a corpse. Unable to move or communicate; takes damage only if it deals Aggravated damage. Disciplines usable at ST discretion.
powers.source: Live from the Succubus Club p.28

powers.name: Horrid Form
powers.notes: Assume a monstrous shape; gain several changes up to your Protean dots. All criticals count as messy; Frenzy checks at +2 Difficulty.

powers.name: Metamorphosis
powers.notes: Change into larger-than-mass animals; otherwise follows Shapechange rules.

powers.name: Blood Form
powers.notes: Become an amorphous mass of blood; can be consumed (creating blood bonds as normal).

powers.name: The Heart of Darkness
powers.notes: Remove and hide your heart. If it takes Aggravated ≥ your Health, you enter torpor; only fire/sunlight can destroy it.
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.85

powers.name: Master of Forms
powers.notes: Take on any animal form; all other Shapechange/Metamorphosis limits still apply.

powers.name: Mist Form
powers.notes: Become a cloud of mist. Takes three turns to activate; each extra Rouse reduces activation by one turn.

powers.name: One with the Land
powers.duration: One day or more, or until disturbed
powers.notes: As Earth Meld, but not limited by material within your Domain.

powers.name: The Unfettered Heart
powers.notes: Your heart moves freely in the chest; only a melee critical can stake you.

powers.name: Swarm
powers.notes: Shapechange into a swarm of insects/reptiles/vermin. Can attack individuals equal to Blood Potency per turn.

powers.name: Face of the Victim
powers.notes: Assume the shape of someone you last fed from. Must be activated in the same scene you slaked at least 1 Hunger from them.
powers.source: Live from the Succubus Club p.28

powers.name: Body Paint
powers.duration: Permanent (unless erased by skin-colored Body Paint)
powers.notes: Create tattoos with personal tweaks. After a week, altering uses Stamina + Resolve.

powers.name: Checkout Time
powers.duration: A set number of nights (max 9) written during creation
powers.notes: Enter deep torpor: no aura, no Rouse, no sunlight/banes damage; waking does not require a Rouse.

powers.name: Elevate
powers.notes: Get high regardless of Humanity/Blush; good distill boosts Dexterity, bad distill penalizes it.

powers.name: Far Reach
powers.notes: Telekinetically push/pull/hold. Maintaining a hold each turn: Resolve + Alchemy, Difficulty 3.

powers.name: Food Stain
powers.notes: Mark someone; anyone who drinks from them becomes obvious to you when encountered. With Auspex 2, you’re aware as soon as feeding occurs.

powers.name: Gaoler's Bane
powers.notes: +2 dice to escape restraints/grapples.

powers.name: Haze
powers.notes: Mist follows you, hindering aim/ID. Can extend to up to five people with an extra Rouse.

powers.name: Mercurian Tongue
powers.duration: One night, or until you feed from someone with your own native language
powers.notes: Speak another language; spend Willpower and feed from another to swap languages.

powers.name: Plug-In
powers.duration: One scene (light a room) or until half battery (charge a device)
powers.notes: Low-level current via touch; stops if contact breaks.

powers.name: Portable Shade
powers.duration: Hours = Stamina + Alchemy test, or until next sunset (whichever first)
powers.notes: Walk in sunlight (Path of the Sun development).

powers.name: Speak From the Heart
powers.duration: Message takes 1 minute; lasts until death or blood is drunk
powers.notes: Embed a message in someone’s blood; the next vampire who drinks receives it. Drinks used affect tone.

powers.name: Advanced Torpor
powers.notes: Induce torpor. Heals as a vampire (always); grants a Rouse reroll unlike normal torpor.

powers.name: Blacklight Surprise
powers.duration: ≥1 hour (ends if the light source breaks)
powers.notes: Makes UV light damage vampires; those already vulnerable take +1 damage.

powers.name: Blood of Mandagloire
powers.duration: Active in herd blood for three nights
powers.notes: Drinkers fall into dreamless sleep; developed within the Second Inquisition.

powers.name: Blue State
powers.duration: Stain persists until an uncomfortable talk happens
powers.notes: Target obsesses over an ally’s failure. Kindred gain Stains if ally violates convictions; mortals hold grudges.

powers.name: Envelop
powers.notes: Mist clings to a single target (one at a time).

powers.name: Friends List
powers.notes: See connections between mortals and Kindred; stronger ties require fewer successes.

powers.name: Mirror of Trust
powers.notes: +3 dice to persuade/intimidate someone into honesty; S.I. development.

powers.name: Red's Flaming Hot Sauce
powers.duration: Until used (fire lasts a scene or more by surroundings)
powers.notes: Supernatural Molotov; spread fire can be put out, but source cannot.

powers.name: Whiff-Its
powers.notes: Smell/track the highest Blood Potency nearby; tie-breaking via a test to distinguish.

powers.name: Counterfeit Discipline (•)
powers.notes: Create a one-dot counterfeit of another Discipline power.

powers.name: Bleed Out
powers.notes: Only thin-bloods can feed from the liquefied corpse. Drinkers gain at least 1 Stain.

powers.name: Saraimu
powers.notes: Can only be created using Fixatio.

powers.name: Chemically-Induced Flashback
powers.notes: Imbue/experience another vampire’s Memorium. Requires Fixatio and Concoct Ashe.
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.45

powers.name: Concoct Ashe
powers.notes: Create Ashe from vampire remains. Requires Fixatio.
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.45

powers.name: Diamond Skin
powers.duration: Until margin from distillation is spent
powers.notes: Reduce physical damage; convert Aggravated to Superficial (not vs fire, acid, sunlight, sorcery).

powers.name: Defractionate
powers.notes: Make preserved blood palatable to any Kindred. Tapping differs by style.

powers.name: Fang-Stinger
powers.notes: Inoculate a mortal; harms vampires who feed. S.I. development.

powers.name: Fireskin
powers.notes: Superheat your body; +1 fire damage with body strikes; immune to fire but vulnerable to cold.

powers.name: Freezer Fluid
powers.notes: Freeze a vampire’s body. S.I. development.

powers.name: Hospital Chains
powers.duration: 2 days per point of margin (crit: 2 days per success)
powers.notes: Prevent healing.

powers.name: Mandagloire
powers.notes: Emit/parlay a gas that paralyzes mortals & supernaturals; Fixatio can lace a drink or burn.

powers.name: Martian Purity
powers.notes: Expel blood-borne illnesses via ignited gases; deals 2 Aggravated Health damage.

powers.name: Mask Off
powers.notes: Gas explosion (no damage) that cancels Blush of Life for the night; oppose with Distillation pool.

powers.name: On-Demand Sunburn
powers.duration: Until unleashed or next sunset (first of the two)
powers.notes: Become a sun battery; harm vampires on touch. Path of the Sun formula.

powers.name: Profane Hieros Gamos (Errata)
powers.notes: Become ideal human form. Does not spare Nosferatu from their bane (errata).

powers.name: Rumor
powers.notes: Make a statement and convince one person.

powers.name: Stay the Falling Sand
powers.duration: One round+ if maintained; expires after one use
powers.notes: Slow time for objects/areas (not living creatures or Kindred).

powers.name: Tank
powers.duration: Until you take damage or scene ends
powers.notes: First incoming damage is reduced by five.

powers.name: TLC
powers.notes: Enhance animal blood so it slakes like mortal blood (cannot slake to 0 by killing an animal).

powers.name: Troll the Pious
powers.duration: Varies by what it is smeared on
powers.notes: Most pools −1 die; True Faith: −2 dice and hallucinations.

powers.name: Counterfeit Discipline (••)
powers.notes: Create a two-dot counterfeit of another Discipline power.

powers.name: Airborne Momentum
powers.notes: Fly at running speed; carrying a human-sized mass reduces you to walking speed. Self-use only.

powers.name: Copycat
powers.notes: Approximate copy of a person; acquaintances may recognize differences vs your distillation margin.

powers.name: Discipline Channeling
powers.notes: Imbue Ashe with Disciplines (Fixatio only). Requires Concoct Ashe.
powers.source: Cults of the Blood Gods p.46

powers.name: Half-Living Conductor
powers.notes: Immune to and can redirect electricity. Attacks use Dexterity + Alchemy; deal 2 damage (Aggravated to mortals, Superficial to vampires).

powers.name: Hollow Leg
powers.duration: One night or until the victim Hunger Frenzies
powers.notes: Poison another Kindred so they cannot slake Hunger; must be tricked/coerced/forced to drink.

powers.name: Juice Box
powers.notes: Alter a formula for any vampire to use. Requires Methuselah Blood.

powers.name: Red State
powers.duration: Permanent (until target drinks a choleric Dyscrasia)
powers.notes: Erase memory of someone’s misdeeds; being told later makes no sense to the target.

powers.name: Short Circuit
powers.notes: Overload batteries/electronics by touch or connected metal to short them out.

powers.name: Toxic Personality
powers.notes: Secrete caustic bile. Use as touch attack or spit (ranged) with an extra Rouse.

powers.name: Vitae MSG
powers.notes: Makes a target especially tempting. Ventrue need 1 less Willpower when off-preference.

powers.name: Counterfeit Discipline (•••)
powers.notes: Create a three-dot counterfeit of a Discipline. Requires a drop of vitae from a matching clan/owner of the Discipline.

powers.name: Da Bomb
powers.notes: Only works when imbibed into mortals.

powers.name: Awaken the Sleeper
powers.notes: Awaken a vampire from torpor. Tapping varies by style.

powers.name: Beast Mode
powers.notes: Gain a single level 5 power from Potence, Celerity, or Fortitude. Must pass a Willpower test to avoid Frenzy on consumption.

powers.name: Flowering Amaranth
powers.duration: Used for the act of diablerie
powers.notes: Share diablerie among thin-bloods: gain a Discipline as if full-blooded (cannot increase it), no gen change, −1 Humanity, black-veined aura.

powers.name: Moment of Clarity
powers.notes: +4 dice to Mental Skill pools, Discipline Skill pools, and mental resistance vs Disciplines; immune to Messy Criticals and Frenzy.

powers.name: Saturn's Flux
powers.duration: Effect begins one day after ingestion
powers.notes: Break Blood Bonds. Mortals suffer no damage; Kindred must take Aggravated to expel.

powers.name: Counterfeit Discipline (••••)
powers.notes: Create a four-dot counterfeit of a Discipline. Requires a drop of vitae from a matching clan/owner of the Discipline.

rituals.name: Astromancy
rituals.effect: Learn information such as Skills, Desires and Convictions about someone
rituals.notes: If you know the correct Birth or Embrace date, you can add 1 die to the Ritual pool. This does not stack if you know both.

rituals.name: Beelzebeatit
rituals.effect: Animals avoid the area.
rituals.notes: Nothing prevents directed or controlled creatures from entering.

rituals.name: Bind the Accusing Tongue
rituals.effect: Prevent someone from communicating something negative about the caster
rituals.notes: Victim can break free by rolling Composure + Resolve.

rituals.name: Blood Apocrypha
rituals.effect: Embed messages into Blood or vessels.
rituals.notes: The first person receives the message if they are the intended recipient or if they have A Taste For Blood.

rituals.name: Blood Walk
rituals.effect: Learn characters generation, name, and sire.
rituals.notes: Requires one Rouse Check from the subject to be performed.

rituals.name: Bloody Message
rituals.effect: Make a message appear to a specific type of person then disappear once read.
rituals.notes: Make the Ritual Roll when enchanting the surface.
rituals.source: Let the Streets Run Red, page 77

rituals.name: Blood to Water
rituals.effect: Turn blood into water.
rituals.notes: Removes all traces of blood.

rituals.name: Clinging of the Insect
rituals.effect: Cling to walls like an insect.
rituals.notes: The user must cling with both their hands and feet.

rituals.name: Coax the Garden
rituals.effect: Use plant life to defend.
rituals.notes: The plants will target anyone who isn't the caster.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 55

rituals.name: Craft Bloodstone
rituals.effect: Craft a tracking stone.
rituals.notes: A caster may have up to as many stones as they have Resolve.

rituals.name: Douse the Fear
rituals.effect: Remove their fear of fire temporarily.
rituals.notes: The power wears off once the scene ends.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 67; Players Guide, page 99

rituals.name: Enrich the Blood
rituals.effect: Make a mortal more nourishing.
rituals.notes: This does not work on Kindred vitae.

rituals.name: Herd Ward (Minor)
rituals.effect: Ward a single kine of a herd to prevent unauthorized feeding.
rituals.notes: Make the Ritual Roll when someone else feeds off the herd.
rituals.source: Let the Streets Run Red, page 77

rituals.name: Letter Ward
rituals.effect: Place a ward on a letter
rituals.notes: Make the Ritual Roll if anyone other than the intended recipient opens it.
rituals.source: Let the Streets Run Red, page 77

rituals.name: Revealing the Crimson Trail
rituals.effect: Reveal traces of spilled blood.
rituals.notes: Very old traces require a Resolve + Awareness test.

rituals.name: Seal the Brand
rituals.effect: Make a tattoo permanent on a vampire
rituals.notes: The process inflicts 1 Superficial damage

rituals.name: Shared Memory
rituals.effect: Observe another's Memoriam.
rituals.notes: Participants observe the events and can offer advice but cannot directly influence the events.

rituals.name: Wake with Evening’s Freshness
rituals.effect: Awakens the caster at any signs of danger during day sleep.
rituals.notes: Do not make the Ritual roll until true danger appears.

rituals.name: Ward Against Ghouls
rituals.effect: Protect themselves against Ghouls.
rituals.notes: Uses standard rules for Wards.

rituals.name: Blood Missive
rituals.effect: Send messages through blood.
rituals.notes: The first person to taste the blood, receives it as if it was intended for them or they possess A Taste for Blood.
rituals.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 29

rituals.name: Sanguine Tidings
rituals.effect: Make a message appear on a mirror when a type of person comes nearby.
rituals.notes: It disappears from the mirror once it's been read once.
rituals.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 29

rituals.name: Preservation
rituals.effect: Preserve an item from the passage of time.
rituals.notes: Only preserves the item from age, ambient elements, and minor accidents. Intentional damage still effects the item.

rituals.name: Rite of Introduction
rituals.effect: Magically broadcast an introduction and identification to any caster of the Foundation of the Chantry Ritual in the same city.
rituals.notes: Caster can withhold but not alter elements of their broadcast.

rituals.name: As Fog on Water
rituals.effect: Walk on water silently.
rituals.notes: This can be ended early or kept to allow them to walk on water for the rest of the night.

rituals.name: Calling the Aura’s Remnants
rituals.effect: Speak with the residual aura of someone who has died.
rituals.notes: The aura only has memories up to the time of death.

rituals.name: Calix Secretus
rituals.cost: One Rouse Check plus additional to be stored
rituals.effect: Store vitae for a later use.
rituals.notes: Two Rouse Checks stored will slake one Hunger.

rituals.name: Communicate with Kindred Sire
rituals.effect: Creates a long-distance telepathic link between Sire and Childe
rituals.notes: Major disturbance on either side breaks the connection.

rituals.name: Craftmaster
rituals.effect: Temporarily gain dots and speciality in certain skills (Academics, Craft, Performance or Science)
rituals.notes: Dots replace any skill that caster already has but gain an extra die if they already have the speciality. On a total failure, caster takes Aggravated Damage.

rituals.name: Depths of Nightmare
rituals.effect: Curse someone with nightmares that cause Willpower Damage, which can't be healed during the Ritual's duration.
rituals.notes: On a total failure, the victim has pleasant dreams and is pointed towards the caster.

rituals.name: Elemental Grasp
rituals.effect: Command your chosen element to interfere with a target
rituals.notes: Target takes Superficial Health Damage and must make an appropriate roll to continue. Caster gains one die to their Ritual pool if the element is already active, like water during a flood.

rituals.name: Enhance Dyscrasia
rituals.effect: Allow multiple Kindred to feed from one Dyscrasia without destroying it.
rituals.notes: Usually, they will use Enrich the Blood first.

rituals.name: Eyes of Babel
rituals.effect: By consuming the eyes and tongue of another, they gain the ability to read and speak any language known by the victim.
rituals.notes: This Ritual may incur Stains.

rituals.name: Illuminate Trail of Prey
rituals.effect: Allows the caster to follow the trail of a specific person.
rituals.notes: The victim's face must be known by the caster.

rituals.name: Le Sang de l'Amour
rituals.effect: Create a connection between two people, providing they desire each other at the time the Ritual is cast
rituals.notes: Both participants can use Resolve + Awareness to get an estimation of where the other is. On a total failure of the initial Ritual, this roll disorients them and their Composure is temporarily reduced by one.
rituals.source: Blood Sigils, page 63; Blood Stained Love, page 153

rituals.name: Soporific Touch
rituals.effect: Convert a dose of vitae to weaken their victim against mundane manipulations or mind-altering Disciplines.
rituals.notes: The Ritual Roll is made after the victim makes contact and is contested against with Stamina + Resolve.

rituals.name: Silentia Mortis
rituals.effect: Replicates Silence of Death (Obfuscate ●), which creates a radius of silence
rituals.notes: If intended for someone other than the caster, they will also have to make their own Rouse Check.

rituals.name: Shroud of Silence
rituals.effect: Prevent sounds from escaping a room.
rituals.notes: Requires vitae from a Kindred who possesses Obfuscate

rituals.name: Stolen Memory
rituals.effect: Access sire's memories.
rituals.notes: Can access memories of grandsire or beyond with Difficulty increase of 2 per generation past their sire.

rituals.name: Tiamat Glistens
rituals.effect: Attune yourself to a place of power, like a Furcus
rituals.notes: Caster gains bonuses to Rituals they cast. Only one caster can be attuned to a place of power. If someone else performs the Ritual, the original caster loses their bonus immediately.

rituals.name: Truth of Blood
rituals.effect: The caster can discern truth from lies.
rituals.notes: The target rolls Composure+Occult to resist. This Ritual cannot get past memory wiping Disciplines.

rituals.name: Unseen Underground
rituals.effect: Become invisible underground.
rituals.notes: Immediately ends if they go above ground, or they take hostile actions, otherwise it only lasts for one hour.

rituals.name: Viscera Garden
rituals.cost: One Rouse Check, additional Rouse Check of blood per month
rituals.effect: Grow Blood-addicted plants that can consume corpses
rituals.notes: Can be eaten by Kindred, they do not slake hunger but they stay down. Mortals who ingest a plant are more susceptible to Disciplines.

rituals.name: Ward against Spirits
rituals.effect: Protect themselves against spirits.
rituals.notes: Uses standard rules for Wards.

rituals.name: Warding Circle against Ghouls
rituals.effect: Protect themselves against Ghouls.
rituals.notes: Uses standard rules for Wards.

rituals.name: Web of Hunger
rituals.effect: Avoid the pull of the Beckoning.
rituals.notes: Without the dagger, this ritual would be 4th level. With the dagger it can be treated as level 2.

rituals.name: Bladed Hands
rituals.effect: Sharpens the user's hands into a weapon.
rituals.notes: Treated as a light piercing Brawl weapon with a +2 modifier.

rituals.name: Bloodless Feast
rituals.effect: Purify blood, creating a clear blood-like substance.
rituals.notes: Those who consume the clear vitae enough are weaker to diablerie.

rituals.name: Blood Sigil
rituals.effect: Create a tattoo on a Kindred which also contains a message
rituals.notes: Can read the message with a Resolve + Occult roll or by Sense the Unseen (Auspex ●). Caster can remove the Blood Sigil by spending Willpower and touching the tattoo.

rituals.name: Communal Vigor
rituals.effect: A Pack Priest shares their Blood Potency with their pack.
rituals.notes: The Priest gains three bonus dice on Dominate and Presence tests against packmates.

rituals.name: Dagon’s Call
rituals.effect: The caster can rupture the blood vessels of a victim from afar.
rituals.notes: The caster can use this up to two additional times, each costing an additional Rouse Check. The opposing roll is Stamina + Resolve.

rituals.name: Deflection of Wooden Doom
rituals.effect: This ritual protects them from being staked.
rituals.notes: Do not roll the Ritual Roll until staked.

rituals.name: Elemental Shelter
rituals.effect: Meld with your chosen element, similar to Earth Meld (Protean ●●●)
rituals.notes: Fire Kolduns must resist terror frenzy before casting this ritual. Koldun's form can be seen with a Wits + Awareness roll or by Sense the Unseen (Auspex ●). If bonded element is removed, such as the fire going out, the Koldun enters torpor.

rituals.name: Essence of Air
rituals.effect: Allows for flight.
rituals.notes: The Camarilla frowns upon this Ritual due to its Masquerade dangers.

rituals.name: Eyes of the Past
rituals.effect: See what happened at their current location in the past.
rituals.notes: It only holds events within the last five years.

rituals.name: Fire in the Blood
rituals.effect: Create anguish of fire in one's blood to incapacitate
rituals.notes: A victim can only be affected by this Ritual once per night.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 67 Players Guide, page 100

rituals.name: Firewalker
rituals.effect: Allow themselves and their comrades to become resistant to fire.
rituals.notes: This ritual can be performed on others, but the fingertip removal must all come from the caster.

rituals.name: Galvanic Ruination
rituals.effect: Short out electronics and wiring nearby.
rituals.notes: Generally, it only affects the range of a warehouse or three-story building, but can be extended by adding 1 Difficulty per additional building.

rituals.name: Gentle Mind
rituals.effect: Protect the mind of a target against Frenzy.
rituals.notes: The caster must share blood with another and cannot cast it upon themselves.

rituals.name: Grim Chrysalis
rituals.effect: Create a cocoon out of hardened vitae that heals damage taken.
rituals.notes: The cocoon itself is hard and protects the user from outside damage to some extent.

rituals.name: Haunted House
rituals.effect: Make a haven appear as if it's haunted.
rituals.notes: The effects last for 10 years.

rituals.name: Herd Ward (Major)
rituals.effect: Ward a herd against unauthorized feeding by warding the door to protect multiple people within.
rituals.notes: Make the Ritual Roll when someone else feeds off the herd.
rituals.source: Let the Streets Run Red, page 77

rituals.name: Illusion of Peaceful Death
rituals.effect: Make a corpse appear as if it'd died a natural death.
rituals.notes: The body must have at least half of the body's blood to succeed.

rituals.name: Illusion of Perfection
rituals.effect: Become a nondescript person to blend into crowds.
rituals.notes: Similar to the ability Mask of a Thousand Faces.

rituals.name: Nepenthe
rituals.effect: Create a draught that can remove Stains, but prolonged use of it can make those Stains permanent
rituals.notes: Using Nepenthe two sessions in a row causes one Stain to become permanent. This is cumulative, e.g. four sessions gives two permanent Stains.

rituals.name: One with the Blade
rituals.cost: One or more Rouse Checks, enough to submerge the weapon.
rituals.effect: Claim ownership of a weapon and protect it from damage.
rituals.notes: Only one weapon can hold this ritual at a time.

rituals.name: Sanguine Watcher
rituals.effect: Create a small rat out of vitae.
rituals.notes: The caster can send the rat to go where they instruct to observe or steal, but the instructions must be very explicit.

rituals.name: Seeing with the Sky's Eyes
rituals.effect: Observe a target from above
rituals.notes: Player can ask one question about location and surrounding per success roll. Critical Wins give 3 extra questions and can gain information about Ambitions, Desires, Convictions and Humanity.

rituals.name: Seeking Tiamat
rituals.cost: One Rouse Check and Aggravated Health damage
rituals.effect: Find veins of the Earth
rituals.notes: Critical wins discover the closest vein and points towards 2 Furcae on that vein

rituals.name: Sleep of Judas
rituals.effect: Incapacitate a vampire by drugging them.
rituals.notes: Make the Ritual Roll when the target is drugged.
rituals.source: Let the Streets Run Red, page 77

rituals.name: Soul of the Hemonculus
rituals.effect: Create a Hemonculus, a shrivelled, smaller and weaker version of the caster, who must obey your every command
rituals.notes: Immune to the sun but cannot be Embraced, made into a ghoul or have a Blood Bond. Vampires slake no Hunger if they drink from it.

rituals.name: Stone of the True Form
rituals.effect: Dispel illusions and creatures altered via Disciplines and Rituals
rituals.notes: Must throw the stone with Dexterity + Athletics. The target resists the Ritual with Resolve + Occult. On a win, illusions are dispelled, shapeshifters are painfully returned to their original form and beings made through Disciplines, like a Vozhd, are separated to their original components.

rituals.name: The Unseen Change
rituals.effect: Lupines entering the area are forced into Wolf Form.
rituals.notes: If they do not succeed on the Ritual Roll against a contested Willpower test, they enter in Lupus Form.

rituals.name: Trespass
rituals.effect: Allows the caster to easily sneak around a building, such as by flowing through crevices that blood can fit through
rituals.notes: Unlike Incorporeal Passage, the caster can be attacked providing they are able to notice the caster.

rituals.name: Viral Haruspex
rituals.effect: Gather information from everyone in an area suffering from a certain disease
rituals.notes: Caster must drink from someone with the disease within 24 hours before casting this Ritual.

rituals.name: Ward against Lupines
rituals.effect: Protects themselves against Werewolves.
rituals.notes: Uses standard rules for Wards.

rituals.name: Warding Circle against Spirits
rituals.effect: Protect themselves against spirits.
rituals.notes: Uses standard rules for Wards.

rituals.name: Balm of Bathory
rituals.effect: Make a balm from the blood of a young mortal to make the user appear younger
rituals.notes: The balm gives the user a temporary Stunning (••••) Merit. However, each subsequent use takes double the amount of mortal blood as the last batch.

rituals.name: Compel the Inanimate
rituals.effect: Give a simple command to an inanimate object which it follows a few minutes later
rituals.notes: The caster must remain in the same general area as the object. Sense the Unseen (Auspex ●) can detect the caster with a Wits + Auspex vs. caster's Composure + Blood Sorcery roll.

rituals.name: Defense of the Sacred Haven
rituals.effect: Protect a haven with mystical darkness from the sun.
rituals.notes: The Ritual roll is made once the sun rises.

rituals.name: Egregore Consultation
rituals.effect: By hosting an illness, the caster is able to enhance Skills by access the experiences of everyone with that illness in the area
rituals.notes: If a Skill is very common in an area, like Finance in New York, the caster can get extra die to their roll, at a maximum of two.

rituals.name: Eyes of the Nighthawk
rituals.effect: Take control of a carnivorous bird and act through them.
rituals.notes: The user can use most non-physical Disciplines through the bird.

rituals.name: Feast of Ashes
rituals.effect: Stop another Kindred from drinking blood for one night.
rituals.notes: The ritual roll is made against the victim’s Resolve + Willpower. The victim can eat the ashes to slake hunger but only down to 3.

rituals.name: Guided Memory
rituals.effect: With the Blood of another vampire, experience their memories guided by them.
rituals.notes: This can be used to unlock Discipline powers, Merits and other gifts.

rituals.name: Incorporeal Passage
rituals.effect: The caster's form becomes ghost-like.
rituals.notes: They may only interact through speech and sight.

rituals.name: Innocence of the Child’s Heart
rituals.effect: Put up a blockade against Scry the Soul to hide diablerie and other vampiric traits.
rituals.notes: There's no record of Nicolai sharing this ritual with his fellow Tremere and is only learned by capturing his notes or by ST discretion.

rituals.name: Innocence's Veil
rituals.effect: Temporarily make traces of Diablerie undetectable.
rituals.dice_pool: Cannot be detected by A Taste for Blood or Scry The Soul
rituals.notes: / Gehenna War, page 48

rituals.name: Invisible Chains of Binding
rituals.effect: Confine a victim to a single spot
rituals.notes: The victim is unable to move from that spot for one hour per success in the margin unless the chain is destroyed or removed.

rituals.name: Land's Sustenance
rituals.effect: Feed from a place of power, turning it into a place of suffering where injuries become more severe.
rituals.notes: Lasts until end of the Story before needing to be renewed. Once per Session, they can automatically pass a number of Rouse Checks equal to their margin on the Ritual roll.

rituals.name: Rending the Sweet Earth
rituals.effect: Pull a vampire from the earth who is using Earth Meld.
rituals.notes: The ritual automatically awakens the other vampire unless they are in torpor or the Ritual Roll is a Critical Win.

rituals.name: Riding the Earth's Vein
rituals.effect: Travel from one furcus to another random one.
rituals.notes: The caster has no control over where they end up. This Ritual is one way and only activates where it was first cast

rituals.name: Protean Curse
rituals.effect: Transform a target into a bat similar to Metamorphosis.
rituals.notes: This cannot be used on the caster.

rituals.name: Ward against Cainites
rituals.effect: Protects themselves against Kindred.
rituals.notes: Uses standard rules for Wards. A vampire examining this ward may read the name of the caster with an Intelligence + Auspex vs Intelligence + Blood Sorcery roll.

rituals.name: Warding Circle against Lupines
rituals.effect: Protects themselves against Werewolves.
rituals.notes: Uses standard rules for Wards.

rituals.name: Seek the Gathered Vitae
rituals.effect: Discovered gatherings of Kindred with a collective Blood Potency of 13 or higher.
rituals.notes: Ghouls count as 1/4th and Duskborn count as 1/2.
rituals.source: Live from the Succubus Club, page 29

rituals.name: Antebrachia Ignium
rituals.effect: Set their arms on fire
rituals.notes: The user is only resistant to fire on their arms.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 67; Players Guide, page 102

rituals.name: Atrocity's Release
rituals.effect: Reverses the effects of Diablerie
rituals.notes: Can be resisted with a Resolve + Blood Sorcery test.

rituals.name: Dominion
rituals.effect: Stop the use of Animalism, Auspex, Dominate, and Presence within a building.
rituals.notes: The area of effect is determined by the amount of Rouse Checks.

rituals.name: Eden’s Bounty
rituals.effect: Drain blood from nearby creatures
rituals.notes: For the remainder of the chapter, mortals suffer 1 die penalty to Physical rolls and take 1 Aggravated health damage.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 56

rituals.name: Elemental Attack
rituals.effect: The Koldun commands their chosen element to attack a foe. This can be a Chain Ritual
rituals.notes: If their element is already active, like Air during a storm, they get an extra die to their Ritual pool. If Chained with Elemental Grasp and Tiamat Glistens, the Ritual becomes a natural disaster, e.g. Tornado, Magma Flow or Tsunami

rituals.name: Escape to True Sanctuary
rituals.cost: In total this ritual requires twelve Rouse Checks.
rituals.effect: Create a one-way portal.
rituals.notes: A caster may only have one set of these circles active at a time.

rituals.name: Fisher King
rituals.effect: Makes the caster one with their land, giving them access to it's secrets. This can be a Chain Ritual
rituals.notes: Can make a Wits + Streetwise or Survival roll to ask questions about the land. The caster can ask one extra question per session. This Ritual lasts until the end of the story. If Chained with Land's Sustenance and Compel the Inanimate, the casters gain complete control over the land and the casters can heal a total of 5 Aggravated damage each night

rituals.name: Heart of Stone
rituals.effect: Turns their heart to stone preventing staking. The Caster also suffers from emotional detachment, taking penalties to Remorse or active Social-related rolls.
rituals.notes: They are unable to use Presence during this ritual's use but gain a bonus when resisting its use on them.

rituals.name: Shaft of Belated Dissolution
rituals.effect: A stake that will seek out another vampire's heart and will cause final death if it finds it.
rituals.notes: Even if an attack with this stake fails to hit the heart, if it hits, a splinter will break and move towards the heart to eradicate the victim.

rituals.name: Simulacrum Gate
rituals.effect: Create a gate to teleport multiple vampires.
rituals.notes: There is only one of these known to exist currently.

rituals.name: Transferring the Soul
rituals.effect: Take over a body from diablerie.
rituals.dice_pool: Intelligence + Blood Sorcery and Intelligence + Oblivion
rituals.notes: This ritual requires another Kindred who knows Oblivion ●●●●●. It is possible to be done by one Kindred who possess level 5 in both powers.

rituals.name: Warding Circle against Cainites
rituals.effect: Protects themselves against Kindred.
rituals.notes: Uses standard rules for Wards.

rituals.name: Foundation of the Chantry
rituals.effect: Make a point of Foundation, so the caster and designees can retrieve broadcasts from Rite of Introduction and send response back.
rituals.notes: Foundation is linked to a Vein of the Earth. Designees must be present to also receive messages. Responses may withhold, but not alter information.

rituals.name: Gift of False Life
rituals.effect: Raise either a single corpse or a group to perform simple single or repetitive tasks.
rituals.notes: Corpses are mindless creatures and do not defend themselves from attacks, decaying as normal for the duration of the ceremony.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 208 Players Guide, page 92

rituals.name: Knowing Stone
rituals.effect: Identify the locations and existences of specific ghosts.
rituals.notes: They must know the ghost's name.

rituals.name: Summon Spirit
rituals.effect: Summon a spirit from the Underworld.
rituals.notes: The wraith will disappear at the end of the scene unless a ceremony is used to keep them there such as Compel Spirit.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 209 Players Guide, page 92

rituals.name: Traveler's Call
rituals.effect: Summon another Shalimite.
rituals.notes: The victim can choose to ignore it, taking -2 to all pools in relation to concentration for one scene. This ceremony is connected to the Cult of Shalim.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 93

rituals.name: Ashen Relic
rituals.prereq: Ashes to Ashes or Oblivion's Sight
rituals.effect: Preservation of a Kindred's body.
rituals.notes: Three successes in the margin preserves more.

rituals.name: Awaken the Homuncular Servant
rituals.effect: Create spies and stalkers out of body parts or small animals.
rituals.notes: The servant can scale or hop walls and hide, but it cannot speak. It is only able to telepathically communicate single images to its creator.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 209 Players Guide, page 93

rituals.name: Blinding the Alloy Eye
rituals.effect: Cameras cannot perceive the user clearly.
rituals.notes: Do not make the ritual roll until the effect is active. This ceremony is connected to the Sabbat.

rituals.name: Compel Spirit
rituals.effect: Bend a wraith to a vampire's will.
rituals.notes: The ritual roll is made against the wraith's Resolve + Composure or Willpower.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 210 Players Guide, page 94

rituals.name: Maw of Ahriman
rituals.effect: Open a portal to the Abyss, usually within their mouth.
rituals.notes: The user cannot speak till it is either cancelled or the next sunrise.

rituals.name: Create Corpse Suit
rituals.prereq: Shadow Perspective or Touch of Oblivion
rituals.effect: Sew a garment made out of mortal flesh that warns the wearer of subtle signs of danger
rituals.notes: The garment is semi-sentient and needs to be persuaded with a test. While worn, the wearer gains a Folkoric Bane and Folkloric Block of the Storyteller's Choice

rituals.name: Create Flesh Golem
rituals.prereq: Aura of Decay or Necrotic Plague
rituals.effect: Build a flesh golem from parts of a corpse
rituals.notes: Can be assembled manually or with the help of Fleshcrafting

rituals.name: Fortezza Sindonica
rituals.effect: Create a barrier that harms wraiths.
rituals.notes: Do not make the Ritual Roll until a wraith attempts to pass. This ceremony is connected to the Hecata.
rituals.source: Trails of Ash and Bone, page 173

rituals.name: Harrowhaunt
rituals.effect: Keep unwanted visitors from their haven.
rituals.notes: Vampires are able to enter making a fear Frenzy check each turn while inside. This ceremony is connected to the Sabbat.

rituals.name: Host Spirit
rituals.effect: Allows the user to open their body to a ghost for possession.
rituals.notes: Alongside the bonus of +2 to Physical Attribute rolls and +2 health, the wraiths Skills can be substituted for the vampire’s own at Storyteller discretion.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 211 Players Guide, page 94

rituals.name: Knit the Veil
rituals.effect: Turn a shroud impenetrable.
rituals.notes: When not disturbed this effect does not change for as many nights as the user's Oblivion rating.
rituals.source: Trails of Ash and Bone, page 174

rituals.name: Name of the Father
rituals.effect: Strike a victim's mind with the empty void of Oblivion, leaving them paralyzed.
rituals.notes: The victim can spend willpower equal to the number of turns they would remain paralyzed to free themselves. This ceremony is connected to the Cult of Shalim.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 94

rituals.name: Shallow Slumber
rituals.prereq: Passion Feast or Touch of Oblivion
rituals.effect: Reduces time spent in torpor.
rituals.notes: Can be used on self on others even when not in torpor.

rituals.name: Shambling Hordes
rituals.effect: Raise a group of aggressive walking dead.
rituals.notes: If left without commands, they attack anyone around them other than their master.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 212 Players Guide, page 95

rituals.name: Wisdom of the Dead
rituals.prereq: Where the Veil Thins or Oblivion's Sight
rituals.effect: Gain information from a corpse skull or head.
rituals.notes: Add two dice to their dice pool if they are still carrying the skull/head for the rest of the night.

rituals.name: Misfortune's Hand
rituals.prereq: Shadow Servant or Touch of Oblivion
rituals.effect: Use the power of entropy to call ruin on an enemy's Backgrounds
rituals.notes: A target can only be affect by one casting of this Ceremony at a time.

rituals.name: Befoul Vessel
rituals.effect: Turn a mortal's blood into poison for other vampires.
rituals.notes: This power leaves no trace other than the mortal dying the next night with the smell of mildew and sweat. This ceremony is connected to the Sabbat.

rituals.name: Bind the Spirit
rituals.effect: Bind a wraith to a specific location or person.
rituals.notes: Bound wraiths have the same powers as spectres.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 212 Players Guide, page 96

rituals.name: Bind to Mortal Form
rituals.effect: Extend the life of a mortal without ghouling them.
rituals.notes: The ceremony does not keep the mortal young, and continues to age both physically and mentally, albeit past their natural lifespan.

rituals.name: Death Rattle
rituals.effect: Inflict the sensory experience of a wraith's death onto a target.
rituals.notes: The victim contests the ritual roll with Composure + Resolve.
rituals.source: Trails of Ash and Bone, page 174

rituals.name: Split the Veil
rituals.effect: Create a tear into a shroud to allow wraiths to enter.
rituals.notes: This Ceremony reduces the density of the veil and can reduce it to absent, allowing wraiths to come through. The veil increased to frayed after the session ends, stopping any more wraiths.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 213 Players Guide, page 96

rituals.name: Ex Nihilo
rituals.cost: Three Rouse Checks and one Willpower point
rituals.effect: Enter the Shadowlands
rituals.notes: The Shadowlands have several rules that do not exist in the world of the living.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 213

rituals.name: Gift of True Life
rituals.effect: Extend a mortal's life by shortening the life of another
rituals.notes: The receiving mortal ages half as quickly until the extra lifespan granted has been spent, after which, they begin to age normally.

rituals.name: Lazarene Blessing
rituals.effect: Bring a fresh corpse back to life
rituals.notes: This lasts until the body dies again or the wraith is exorcised from the host.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 214 Players Guide, page 96

rituals.name: Pit of Contemplation
rituals.effect: Cast an enemy into Oblivion itself.
rituals.notes: Mortals sucked in are instantly killed. This ceremony is connected to the Cult of Shalim.
rituals.source: Cults of the Blood Gods, page 94
